description: Analyst consensus for one KRX ticker, built from the archived research history: mean/median/min/max target price across brokerages, the spread between them, the rating distribution, and a revision log of every target-price and rating change each house has made. Consensus uses each house's latest view, so a weekly publisher does not outvote a quarterly one. Params: ?window=30d|90d|180d|365d (default 90d). Costs $0.12 in USDC per call, settled via x402.
name: research_consensus_ticker
